Hi Maya,

We just spun up a self-serve trial and are preparing for a full product demo next week. Before the demo, our infra/security lead asked for a short 15-minute tech check to confirm networking and model throughput expectations (we're evaluating for a customer-facing autocomplete feature, ~600 requests/min peak).

Key points we want to touch on:
